findings.correction: Jinho hyung was crazy about electronic devices, especially capsules.
findings.current: Jinho hyung was helpless when it came to electronic devices, especially capsules.
findings.defect: 사족을 못 쓰다 marks irresistible enthusiasm, not incompetence. “Helpless when it came to electronic devices” commonly reads as unskilled, reversing the characterization the next lines confirm.
findings.rationale: The following beats (named user, IT blog, 빠삭하잖아, knowing every domestic model) require an enthusiast reading.
findings.source: 전자 기기, 그중에서도 캡슐이라면 사족을 못 쓰는 그다.

findings.defect: A vocative slur aimed at Hayeon is replaced by a generic curse, softening the line and dropping the target.
findings.rationale: 망할 년 is sibling-directed profanity, parallel to later 똑똑한 년 and 잔인한 년; the rules forbid sanitizing that register.

findings.correction: That look. That tone. He meant it. The writing I could see was invisible to Jinho hyung.
findings.current: He was serious. The writing I could see was invisible to Jinho hyung.
findings.defect: The narrator’s evidence—Jinho’s expression and speaking manner—is omitted, leaving only a summary that he was serious.
findings.rationale: The staccato cues are how Taekyung concludes the blank-page claim is genuine, not a joke.
findings.source: 저 표정. 말투. 진심이다. 내게 보이는 이 글씨가, 진호 형에게는 보이지 않는다.

findings.correction: The metal hunk was the junk capsule Taekyung had picked up the day before.
findings.current: The metal hunk was the old capsule he had picked up the day before.
findings.defect: Unresolved “he” can attach to Seong Jinho in this POV, changing who salvaged the capsule.
findings.rationale: The next sentence treats the prank and the discarding as Taekyung’s; the Korean omitted subject should not be reassigned to Jinho.
findings.source: 쇳덩어리의 정체는 전날 주워 온 고물 캡슐이었다.

findings.correction: That still puts you in Grade 1. / There were so many Grade 7s I thought it was a slot machine that had hit the jackpot.
findings.current: That still puts you in the top grade. / There were so many Grade 7s, I thought it was a slot machine that had hit the jackpot.
findings.defect: 1등급 is paraphrased as “top grade” while 7등급 is “Grade 7s,” hiding the 1–9 exam band and inviting a school-year reading of 7.
findings.rationale: The mock-exam joke depends on the numbered 등급 scale (1 best, 7 poor, sevens like a jackpot), which the draft splits and partially blurs.
findings.source: 그 정도면 1등급이잖아. / 7등급이 하도 많아서 무슨 잭팟 터진 슬롯머신인 줄.

findings.correction: The broth made spicy with Cheongyang peppers sliced and added separately.
findings.current: The broth made spicy with hot green chilies sliced and added separately.
findings.defect: 청양고추 is a specific Korean pepper, not generic hot green chilies.
findings.rationale: The named ingredient is the source of the broth’s heat; a generic chili loses that food term.
findings.source: 따로 썰어 넣은 청양고추로 매콤하게 끓여진 국물.

summary: Several semantic defects: Jinho’s capsule obsession is rendered as possible incompetence; a sister-directed slur is genericized; Jinho’s face/tone evidence is collapsed; the junk capsule’s picker-up is ambiguous.
